Question
========
Which of the following code snippets correctly uses mutate() to convert height from centimeters to meters?

Answerlist
----------

* mutate(height = height / 100)

* mutate(height / 100 = height)

* mutate(height <- height / 100)

* mutate(height = select(height / 100))
